meta.description: Registry for perturbation classes, stress-test inputs, and expected formal behavior in Phase 3.

perturbation_classes.description: Variation of the null threshold epsilon_null.
Deformation or shift of the admissibility window A.
Injection of noise or bias into the residue state R.
Rotation or drift of the orientation frame -(i).
Variation in the number of concurrent continuation branches.
Change in the length or connectivity of transport paths in NavT.
Alteration of the criteria for formal object equivalence.
Change in the application sequence of symbolic rewrite rules.
Scaling of the number of recursive iterations T.
Simultaneous variation of multiple constraint parameters.
